entities.summary: Liakat Ali Errol Alibux is a Surinamese politician historically associated with the PALU. He also served as Prime Minister of Suriname for 11 months, from 1983 to 1984. Errol Alibux was a political leaders from Paramaribo (b. 1948-11-30, Paramaribo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
